summary: 新西兰较小的本土猫头鹰 morepork 在外来物种进入后延续至今。它靠敏锐感官夜猎并照料幼鸟，但栖息地变化和食物链中的毒物仍威胁其生存，其叫声还承载毛利文化中的含义。
logic: 比较两种本土猫头鹰的命运
观察繁殖、夜猎与天敌关系
追踪种群风险和保护行动
解释不同叫声的文化意义

paragraphs.brief: 作为一个由鸟类为主的动物群的岛国，新西兰曾经拥有一个现已灭绝的猫头鹰物种，即以其独特呼声命名的笑猫头鹰。
sentences: As an island country with a fauna dominated by birds, New Zealand was once home to an owl species which is now extinct, the laughing owl, named for its distinctive cry.
作为一个由鸟类为主的动物群的岛国，新西兰曾经拥有一个现已灭绝的猫头鹰物种，即以其独特呼声命名的笑猫头鹰。
This bird was widespread throughout the islands when European settlers arrived in the middle of the 19th century and it remained in good numbers for some years thereafter.
当19世纪中叶欧洲定居者抵达时，这只鸟在群岛上很普遍，几年后一直停留在好数量。
Where other native birds suffered from predation by the Polynesian rat, the laughing owl turned the tables and adapted its diet to include the rodent.
在其他本地鸟类遭受波利尼西亚老鼠掠夺的地方，笑猫头鹰翻了桌子，调整了饮食，将鼠类也包括在内。
It was also capable of catching and killing the other New Zealand owl, the morepork, and even larger birds, such as the weka.
它还能够捕捉和杀死其他新西兰猫头鹰、更肥的猪，甚至更大的鸟，如Weka。
However, the laughing owl was wiped out around the beginning of the 20th century, its demise caused by specimen collectors, habitat changes, and non-native predators including cats and stoats.
然而，在20世纪初，笑猫头鹰被消灭了，其消亡是由标本采集器、生境变化以及非本地的捕食者，包括猫和小鹿造成的。
Surprisingly, it is the smaller owl, the morepork, that has managed to survive until this day.
令人惊讶的是，小猫头鹰，更肥的猪，一直活到今天。

paragraphs.brief: 涂满了黄眼睛和长尾巴的深褐色，从头到尾长约29厘米，重175克。
sentences: Speckled dark brown, with yellow eyes and long tails, they are around 29 centimetres long from head to tail and 175 grams in weight.
涂满了黄眼睛和长尾巴的深褐色，从头到尾长约29厘米，重175克。
Moreporks have fringes on the edge of their feathers, so they can fly almost silently and not alert potential prey.
更多的猪在羽毛边缘有边缘所以它们几乎可以无声飞翔并且不引起潜在猎物的注意
They have acute hearing and their large eyes are very sensitive to light.
他们有急性听力他们的大眼睛对光非常敏感

paragraphs.brief: 在野外，更多的猪通常在10月份开始筑巢，尽管有记录表明有两种标本在冬季中叶筑巢，可能受到充足食物供应的刺激。
sentences: Moreporks nest in tree hollows, in clumps of plants, or in cavities among rocks and roots.
树洞中、植物堆中或岩石和根部之间的洞穴中，有更多的猪窝。
In the wild, moreporks usually start nesting in October, although two specimens have been recorded nesting in mid-winter, possibly stimulated by an ample food supply.
在野外，更多的猪通常在10月份开始筑巢，尽管有记录表明有两种标本在冬季中叶筑巢，可能受到充足食物供应的刺激。
The female lays up to three white eggs, which she incubates for 20 to 30 days.
雌鸟最多产下三个白蛋孕育了20到30天
During this time, she rarely hunts, and the male brings food to her.
在此期间，她很少打猎，而雄性给她带来了食物。

paragraphs.brief: 眼睛直到孵化后的第八天才睁开
sentences: Once the chicks hatch, she stays mainly on the nest until the young owls are fully feathered.
一旦小鸡孵化，她主要留在巢里直到年轻的猫头鹰完全羽毛。
When hatched, chicks are covered in light grey down and have their eyes closed.
孵化后，小鸡被灰色蒙上眼睛，闭上眼睛。
The eyes do not open until the eighth day after hatching.
眼睛直到孵化后的第八天才睁开
They can fly at around 35 days.
他们可以飞行35天左右。

paragraphs.brief: 在白天，这些小鸟有时暴徒更懒散把他们赶离他们的巢穴；他们强迫困苦的捕食者寻找一个更和平的地方。
sentences: By day, moreporks sleep in roosts.
一天，更多的猪睡在公鸡。
By night, they hunt a variety of animals – mainly large invertebrates including scarab and huhu beetles, moths, caterpillars and spiders.
到了晚上，他们猎杀各种动物，主要是大型无脊椎动物，包括草莓和甲虫、飞蛾、毛虫和蜘蛛。
They also take small birds and mice.
他们也抓小鸟和小老鼠
They can find suitable food in pine forest as well as native forest.
他们可以在松林和本地森林中找到合适的食物。
A morepork uses its sharp talons to catch or stun its prey, which it then carries away in its bill.
一个更蠢的人用尖利的爪子来抓捕或击晕猎物，然后用帐单带走了猎物。
Moreporks are clever hunters, and birds such as robins, grey warblers and fantails can end up as their prey.
更多的猪是聪明的猎人鸟儿，如Robins，灰色的战马和尾巴最终会成为它们的猎物
In the day, these small birds sometimes mob drowsy moreporks and chase them away from their roosts; they force the sleepy predators to search for a more peaceful spot.
在白天，这些小鸟有时暴徒更懒散把他们赶离他们的巢穴；他们强迫困苦的捕食者寻找一个更和平的地方。

paragraphs.brief: 罪犯是五对更胖的人要么吃，要么赶走新来的人
sentences: Moreporks have proved to be ungracious hosts.
更多的猪被证明是邪恶的主人。
Scientists trying to establish a population of plovers on Motuora Island in New Zealand’s Hauraki Gulf were mystified as to why only two birds survived out of the 75 placed there.
科学家试图在新西兰豪拉基湾的莫图奥拉岛建立一个鸻鸟种群，然而放到岛上的 75 只鸟只有两只存活，令他们百思不解。
The culprits turned out to be five pairs of moreporks that ate or chased away the new arrivals.
罪犯是五对更胖的人要么吃，要么赶走新来的人

paragraphs.brief: 虽然更多的猪肉仍然被认为是比较常见的，但由于掠夺和生境的丧失，数量可能逐渐减少。
sentences: Although moreporks are still considered to be relatively common, it is likely that numbers are in gradual decline due to predation and loss of habitat.
虽然更多的猪肉仍然被认为是比较常见的，但由于掠夺和生境的丧失，数量可能逐渐减少。
As the female is a hole-nester, she is vulnerable to predators such as stoats and possums during the breeding season, and eggs and chicks will also be at risk from rats.
由于雌性是洞腹，在繁殖季节，雌性易受食肉动物的伤害，如小鹿和负鼠，而卵和小鸡也会受到老鼠的威胁。
The use of pesticides is another possible threat to the owls, though not a direct one.
使用杀虫剂是对猫头鹰的另一个可能的威胁，但不是直接的威胁。
As moreporks are at the top of the food chain, they could be affected by an accumulative poison by consuming prey that has ingested poison.
由于更多的猪身位于食物链的顶端，它们可能会受到食用食用毒药的猎物的累积毒物的影响。

paragraphs.brief: 猪头不仅具有新西兰唯一的本地猫头鹰，还具有象征意义和精神意义，因此，在监测鸟儿时，希望猪头能继续生存和壮大。
sentences: The New Zealand Department of Conservation is taking steps to ensure the preservation of New Zealand’s only native owl.
新西兰自然保护部正在采取措施，确保新西兰唯一的母猫受到保护。
The department is involved in measuring the population of moreporks and has put transmitters on a number of birds to determine survival and mortality.
该部参与测量更多猪群的人口，并安装了若干鸟类的发射机，以确定生存和死亡率。
As well as being New Zealand’s only native owl, the morepork has symbolic and spiritual importance, so in monitoring the birds it is hoped that the morepork will continue to survive and thrive.
猪头不仅具有新西兰唯一的本地猫头鹰，还具有象征意义和精神意义，因此，在监测鸟儿时，希望猪头能继续生存和壮大。

paragraphs.brief: 黄昏时，在森林和公园里可以听到较松软的声音，因为它呼吁其他较松软的动物和要求拥有领土。
sentences: At dusk, the melancholy sound of the morepork can be heard in forests and parks as it calls to other moreporks and claims territory.
黄昏时，在森林和公园里可以听到较松软的声音，因为它呼吁其他较松软的动物和要求拥有领土。
Its Māori name (ruru) echoes its two-part cry.
毛利族的名字(ruru)呼喊着两部分。
In the tradition of the Māori people of New Zealand, the morepork, or ruru, was often seen as a careful guardian.
在新西兰毛利人的传统中，较弱者或鲁鲁人往往被视为谨慎的监护人。
A number of sayings referred to the bird’s alertness.
许多说法都提到鸟儿的警惕性。
As a bird of the night, it was associated with the spirit world.
作为夜里的鸟儿，它与灵魂世界联系在一起。
Moreporks were believed to act as messengers to the gods in the heavens, flying along spiritual paths in the sky.
据信，更多的猪是作为信使在天上的诸神，沿着精神路径在天空飞行。
They were the mediums used to communicate with the gods.
他们是用来与众神沟通的媒介。
The occasional high, piercing call of the morepork signified bad news, but the lower-pitched and more common “ruru” call heralded good news.
偶尔高音、尖锐的呼声表示坏消息，但低调、更常见的“鲁鲁”呼声预示着好消息。

items.en: Early European settlers made detailed studies of the morepork.
items.zh: 早期的欧洲定居者详细研究了较猪肉。
items.why: 文章只说“European settlers arrived…in the middle of the 19th century”,并未提到他们对 morepork 做过“detailed studies”, 婚无肯定也无否定信息。

items.en: The Polynesian rat had a negative effect on the number of laughing owls.
items.zh: 波利尼西亚大鼠对笑猫头鹰的数量产生了负面影响。
items.why: 其他本土鸟类遭波利尼西亚鼠捕食，笑鸮却调整食谱，反而把这种鼠当作食物。

items.en: The laughing owl was larger than the morepork.
items.why: 在两种猫头鹰的比较中，文章称新西兰鹰鸮是较小的一种，因此笑鸮较大。

items.en: Rats pose a risk to young moreporks.
items.zh: 老鼠对年轻的猪头构成危险
items.why: 文中直接说鼠类会威胁新西兰鹰鸮的蛋和雏鸟。

items.en: The New Zealand Department of Conservation is hoping to limit the population of moreporks.
items.zh: 新西兰保护部希望限制更多猪人口。
items.why: 保护部门采取措施的目的是保育这种猫头鹰，题干把目标说成限制数量。

items.en: Other bird species are frightened away when they hear the morepork’s cry.
items.zh: 其他鸟类在听到更鸟人的呼喊时，会害怕。
items.why: 文中描写了小鸟白天围攻并赶走鹰鸮，没有说它们听见鹰鸮叫声就会受惊逃走。

items.en: In Māori tradition, the low call of the morepork had negative associations.
items.zh: 在毛利人的传统中，较弱的猪群的呼声低落，形成了消极的协会。
items.why: 尖厉的高声预示坏消息，较低的叫声预示好消息；题干弄反了低声的含义。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词，可含数字。

pairs: 第 5 段 · 第 4 句
第 1 段 · 第 4 句
points: 文章只说“European settlers arrived…in the middle of the 19th century”,并未提到他们对 morepork 做过“detailed studies”, 婚无肯定也无否定信息。
回到对应内容“涂满了黄眼睛和长尾巴的深褐色，从头到尾长约29厘米，重175克”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: Surprisingly, it is the smaller owl, the morepork, ….
“that has managed to survive until this day”修饰前面的 owl。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 owl，再把修饰信息接回主句。
In the wild, moreporks usually start nesting in October, ….
连接词 although 引出“although two specimens have been recorded nesting in mid-winter, possibly stimulated by an ample food supply”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: One native bird in New Zealand that has managed to survive the introduction of non-native species
新西兰的一只本地鸟类成功存活下来引进了非本地物种
